{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Remove rows with sentinel value in biomarker_baseline
valid_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999].copy()

# Compute change in biomarker from baseline to final
valid_data['biomarker_change'] = valid_data['biomarker_final'] - valid_data['biomarker_baseline']

# Check for balance in covariates between arms
# Check arm distribution across severity
severity_by_arm = pd.crosstab(valid_data['arm'], valid_data['severity'])
print('Severity distribution by arm:\n', severity_by_arm)

# Check arm distribution across sites
site_by_arm = pd.crosstab(valid_data['arm'], valid_data['site'])
print('\nSite distribution by arm:\n', site_by_arm)

# Check arm distribution across sex
sex_by_arm = pd.crosstab(valid_data['arm'], valid_data['sex'])
print('\nSex distribution by arm:\n', sex_by_arm)

# Check arm distribution across age
age_by_arm = valid_data.groupby('arm')['age'].agg(['mean', 'std'])
print('\nAge distribution by arm:\n', age_by_arm)"}
